data.key: Forbidden Ki Power ~ Greater Hidden Magic
data.name: Greater Hidden Magic
data.description: As long as he has at least 1 point in his ki pool, all of the black asp's items are constantly under the effects of magic aura. As an immediate action, he can spend 2 ki points to cause himself and any magic items he is carrying to appear to be nonmagical (as if he had cast greater magic aura; see page 219) for %1 hours.|MonkLVL
